# Renode external control client (adapted)

Client for Renode's external control protocol, used by `src/mcu`
([ADR 0082](../../docs/decisions/0082-renode-engine-integration.md)).

| File | Origin | Changes |
|---|---|---|
| `renode_api.h` | Renode 1.16.1 portable package, `tools/external_control_client/include/renode_api.h`, SHA-256 `33102605ecd4c4a52ff4fe0844c98cb79ccce5f29a0747243584b4c71b66ecee` | none |
| `renode_api.c` | same package, `lib/renode_api.c`, SHA-256 `7e210d973799f131fcd4fcfd0540d02ceb7919968e1d0d5bc34d8e0d7de36dec` | generated by `tests/experiments/renode-client/prepare.py` (native transport, explicit frees instead of GNU cleanup attributes, `#pragma pack`, bounded payloads, protocol errors retire the stream; see [SN-019](../../docs/experiments/SN-019-results.md)), then by hand: the callback table belongs to the connection, `renode_set_operation_timeout()`, and the UART command (`renode_get_uart`, `renode_uart_write`, `renode_register_uart_callback`, ADR 0086) |
| `renode_api_simnodus.h` | SimNodus | declaration of the additions |
| `transport.h`, `transport.c` | SimNodus | loopback-only TCP for Winsock and POSIX, one deadline per operation |

Renode commit `d66b0c2aa3d420408eccecfd1d3bab0fd702a6db`. The upstream code is
MIT, Copyright (c) Antmicro ([LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)). SimNodus additions are
MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Ricardo Kerschbaumer.

The matching server is `resources/renode/LoopbackControl.cs`: the same
generator's output from the pinned upstream C# sources listed in
`tests/experiments/renode-client/upstream.json`, with the namespace renamed to
`SimNodus.Renode`, plus the SimNodus UART command (ADR 0086). Its generated SHA-256 before the rename was
`4866987b6e5db5283fd0fe1ae84c867c951568dc3176d43ae0f0f951e9d7014b`. It keeps the
Antmicro and Realtime Embedded (socket provider) notices; the license text it
refers to is `resources/renode/licenses/MIT.txt`.
